name: Country band for a wedding: Fire and Fly, Meghan Clarisse
seoTitle: Country band for a wedding: Fire and Fly, Meghan Clarisse
description: Here’s Meghan Clarisse and her band playing Fire and Fly, one of her own songs. She can also play solo, or as a duo with pedal steel or electric guitar.
more: Alongside her own songs, Meghan plays covers like Jolene, Folsom Prison Blues and Dreams by Fleetwood Mac. Her album Shadows of a Ghost Town won the 2026 Josie Music Award for Folk/Americana Album of the Year. The five-piece band is the size to book when you want people dancing at a wedding reception or a big party.
